note: What the player's captured red-science sheet does before any round 15 lane starts. Not a target: a number here may only be corrected by a measurement that says WHICH number moved and why. Wall seconds were measured while the fast tier ran concurrently and are advisory only; the gate never judges on time, because the run is bounded by ops so that its counts are reproducible on a busy host.

policy.denominator_floor: validate_attempts may never fall below the baseline
policy.monotone: no code rate may rise; a code absent from the baseline has baseline 0, so a renamed or brand new code is caught by the same rule
policy.ops_is_an_instrument: search_budget is injected into a private copy at measurement time and is NEVER written into the committed prepared_input.json; tests/golden/lib/runner.py refuses a case carrying a generation option.
policy.rate: a code's count divided by the candidates that reached validate; a raw total falls when fewer candidates are judged, which is not an improvement
policy.stage_floor: the run must still reach search or done; breaking preflight zeroes every BP_V_ code and would read as a triumph
policy.suppression_guard: tests/test_census_codes_live.lua proves each counted code can still be provoked; deleting an emitter zeroes its census and turns that test red in the same run.
